title: RBI Issues NBFC Miscellaneous Supervisory Directions, 2026, With a New PCA Framework
case_name: Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies - Miscellaneous) Supervisory Directions, 2026
card_summary: The RBI's new NBFC supervisory directions, issued as RBI/DoS/2026-27/467, took effect immediately. Upper and Middle Layer NBFCs running ten or more service delivery units must set up a Core Financial Services Solution and file quarterly progress reports. It also requires a review of loan and EMI practices for unfair terms, plus a Prompt Corrective Action framework keyed to capital and asset quality.
card_tip: NBFCs in the Upper and Middle Layers should check their CFSS rollout and lending practices now; the new PCA framework means early warning triggers can escalate into exit conditions and public disclosure.
verification_notes: Circular reference (RBI/DoS/2026-27/467), the 31 July 2026 date, the CFSS requirement for Upper and Middle Layer NBFCs with ten or more service delivery units, the lending-practice review requirement, and the new PCA framework are confirmed against the RBI's own Master Directions page and corroborated by TaxGuru and Lexplosion. Chapter-level PCA thresholds were not independently verified beyond the summaries reviewed.
